title: Cytosporone E analogues as BRD4 inhibitors for cancer treatment: molecular docking and molecular dynamic investigations.
authors: Makki, Alaa A; Ibraheem, Walaa; Alzain, Abdulrahim A
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟筛选BRD4蛋白的小分子抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽含物理模拟但与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Cancer is considered one of the worldwide life-threatening and leading causes of human mortality. In 2020, 19,292,789 cancer cases and 9,958,133 cancer deaths have been estimated worldwide. Therefore, efforts have been devoted to discover novel anticancer agents. Bromodomains have a vital role in the regulation of transcription. Many reports have shown that bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD4) is an important target for cancer therapeutics. In this study, several in silico approaches were utilized to discover new inhibitors against the BRD4 protein using the Schrodinger suite. A library of 27 cytosporone E derivatives was docked into the active site of the BRD4 protein. Docked ligands showed docking scores ranging between -11.289 to -3.992 Kcal/mol. Ligands 1-4 showed better binding affinities with docking scores ranging from -11.289 to -8.917 Kcal/mol compared to the reference ligand BI-2536 (-8.426 Kcal/mol). These ligands displayed favorable MM-GBSA free binding energy. Also, ligands 1-4 were subjected to molecular dynamics simulations for 100 ns to get insight into the ligand-binding stability. These compounds exhibited an average RMSD below 2.8 A, indicating the stability of the compounds with BRD4 protein. Further, Moreover, ligands 1-3 displayed favorable AMDET properties (absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity). These new compounds might be potential leads to combat cancer.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 癌症被认为是全球范围内威胁生命并导致人类死亡的主要原因之一。2020年，全球估计有19,292,789例癌症病例和9,958,133例癌症死亡。因此，人们致力于发现新型抗癌药物。溴结构域在转录调控中发挥重要作用。许多研究报告表明，含溴结构域蛋白4（BRD4）是癌症治疗的重要靶点。在本研究中，利用Schrodinger套件采用多种计算机模拟方法，以发现针对BRD4蛋白的新型抑制剂。将27个胞孢子酮E衍生物库对接至BRD4蛋白的活性位点。对接配体的对接分数介于-11.289至-3.992 Kcal/mol之间。与参考配体BI-2536（-8.426 Kcal/mol）相比，配体1-4显示出更好的结合亲和力，对接分数范围为-11.289至-8.917 Kcal/mol。这些配体表现出有利的MM-GBSA自由结合能。此外，对配体1-4进行了100 ns的分子动力学模拟，以深入了解配体结合的稳定性。这些化合物表现出平均RMSD低于2.8 Å，表明化合物与BRD4蛋白结合稳定。进一步地，配体1-3还显示出良好的AMDET性质（吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性）。这些新化合物可能成为对抗癌症的潜在先导物。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
